First release of HW Glance: every sensor on your Linux desktop and a Task Manager style process list, in one window.

A background collector (`hwglanced`, a systemd user service) records every reading. The window (`hwglance`) shows them in per-device cards, and an optional bar widget does the same for the Omarchy desktop.

## Highlights

- Device cards for the CPU, GPU, memory, each drive, the motherboard and an integrated GPU, with current, min, max and average values and a 30 minute history.
- Warning and critical limits with colour marks and desktop notifications.
- A process list grouped as Apps, Background and System, with per-process GPU use and safe End task and Force kill actions.
- Opt-in plain-text readouts for status bars and scripts.
- Sensors are read only, and nothing leaves your machine.

## Install

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.1.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced
sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper   # optional: CPU package power and memory speed
hwglance-bar-widget install                   # Omarchy only
```

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed). It installs for your user and asks for root only for the optional helper:

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.1.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.1.0-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

From source: clone the repository and run `packaging/install.sh` (needs Rust 1.95 or newer).

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. What you need, and what each optional component adds, is in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).

## Known limitations

This release was tested on one desktop (AMD Ryzen, NVIDIA GPU, Omarchy on Hyprland). Other hardware may show missing or oddly named readings, and the window is English only. The [full list](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#known-limitations) is in the README. Bug reports with the output of `hwglanced --once --json` are welcome.
